query:
SELECT count(*) AS "n!"
        FROM album_tracks bt JOIN tracks t ON t.id = bt.track_id
        WHERE bt.album_id = $2
          AND lower(t.title) IN (SELECT lower(t2.title) FROM album_tracks at
                                 JOIN tracks t2 ON t2.id = at.track_id
                                 WHERE at.album_id = $1)
